method: Generate empty rooms; composite authentic artwork photos independently. Illustrative scale only.
common: Photorealistic editorial architectural interior photograph of a luxurious oceanfront home, landscape 3:2. Straight-on camera exactly perpendicular to main wall. An original 24x36 inch portrait artwork will be composited separately later: leave central wall x40..60%, y10..54% completely EMPTY, no artwork, no frame, no placeholder, no wall sculpture, no text or watermark. Low console top around y63%, all decor only far left x<36% or far right x>65%, no foliage overlapping central wall. The room must feel designed and lived in with sophisticated ocean-inspired abstract textures and sumptuous furnishings, never nautical novelty decor, no fish ornaments, no anchors, no literal underwater fantasy. Soft neutral daylight, physically coherent shadows, main wall well illuminated to match a brightly photographed metallic textured painting.

scenes.dark-scales: A refined deep-ocean salon in a luxury coastal penthouse. Main hanging wall is a medium-light smoky blue-gray microcement, not dark, to balance silver artwork. Sculptural low charcoal oak console with subtly rippled fronts, silver travertine top; polished nickel accents, black ceramic vessel on far right, few large books far left. Curved petrol-blue velvet lounge chair partially visible lower right, pale gray boucle sofa edge lower left. Organic oval silver-gray stone coffee table. Silvery silk rug with very subtle wave-like pattern. Tall window at left reveals a blue ocean horizon beyond sheer ivory curtains. Refined abstract water movement, charcoal, teal and silver. No plants in center. Broad soft daylight from left, neutral white balance. High-end residential design, richly layered but restrained.
scenes.mermaid-tail: An exquisite pearlescent oceanfront sitting room. Main hanging wall very pale sea-glass blue-green polished plaster, softly luminous. A low pale limestone console with elegantly curved ends and subtle vertical fluting, top at y64%. At console far left a small stack of cream books and pale pink glass bowl, at far right one iridescent translucent glass vase. Curved ivory boucle lounge chair lower right with pale aqua silk cushion. Rounded pale blush ottoman and edge of curved cream sofa lower left. Organic glass coffee table on softly sculpted pale stone base, cream rug with restrained fluid contours. Tall window at right with sheer white linen shows ocean horizon. Mother-of-pearl, pale aqua, blush and champagne metal details. Quiet luxury with abstract shell and water-inspired curves, no shell figurines. Bright soft neutral daylight from right, no strong sun patches.
